declarations.name: QFA.Assembly.AnalyticChain.exists_profile_of_compactData
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_profile_of_compactData
    (hExtension : CompactToSchwartzEndpoint)
    (hSpectral : WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    {v L : RealL2} {G H : Fin 3 → RealL2} {N : ℝ}
    (hDerivatives : CompactDerivativeData v G H L)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (hConvection : ∀ V : Space →ᵇ ComplexVector,
      (fun x : Space => V x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x : Space => complexifyL2 v x) →
        N ≤ ‖V‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (‖L‖ ^ 2)) :
    SchwartzDerivativeWitnesses (complexifyL2 v)
        (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L) ∧
      NativeSpectralRealization (complexifyL2 v)
        (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L) ∧
      ∃ V : Space →ᵇ ComplexVector,
        (fun x : Space => V x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x : Space => complexifyL2 v x) ∧
          ScalarProfile (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) (‖L‖ ^ 2) ‖V‖ N

declarations.name: QFA.Assembly.AnalyticChain.exists_absorption_of_compactData
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_absorption_of_compactData
    (hExtension : CompactToSchwartzEndpoint)
    (hSpectral : WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    {v L : RealL2} {G H : Fin 3 → RealL2} {N d ν : ℝ}
    (hDerivatives : CompactDerivativeData v G H L)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (hConvection : ∀ V : Space →ᵇ ComplexVector,
      (fun x : Space => V x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x : Space => complexifyL2 v x) →
        N ≤ ‖V‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (‖L‖ ^ 2))
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hSmall : (‖v‖ ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4)
    (hEnstrophy : d / 2 + ν * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ≤ N) :
    SchwartzDerivativeWitnesses (complexifyL2 v)
        (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L) ∧
      NativeSpectralRealization (complexifyL2 v)
        (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L) ∧
      ∃ (V : Space →ᵇ ComplexVector) (η : ℝ),
        (fun x : Space => V x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x : Space => complexifyL2 v x) ∧
        ScalarProfile (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) (‖L‖ ^ 2) ‖V‖ N ∧
        η = ν - nonlinearCoefficient (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) ∧
        0 < η ∧
        4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * N ^ 4 ≤
          ((‖v‖ ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2)) * (‖L‖ ^ 2) ^ 4 ∧
        N ≤ (ν - η) * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ∧
        d + 2 * η * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0

QFA.Assembly.TailComparison.comparisonData_of_restartData
declarations.signature:
theorem comparisonData_of_restartData
    {ν s T : ℝ}
    {u v : ℝ → QFA.Representation.RealSpatialL2}
    {G : ℝ → Fin 3 → QFA.Representation.RealSpatialL2}
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop}
    (hrestart : QFA.Assembly.Restart.RestartData ν u G s)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hg_nonnegative : ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ g t)
    (hg_integrable : IntervalIntegrable g volume (0 : ℝ) T)
    (hprod : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun r => g r * ‖timeTranslate s u r - v r‖ ^ 2) volume (0 : ℝ) T)
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good r)
    (hv_trace : Tendsto v (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u s)))
    (hv_initial : v 0 = u s)
    (hrelative : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, Good r →
      ∀ t ∈ Icc r T,
        ‖timeTranslate s u t - v t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖timeTranslate s u r - v r‖ ^ 2 +
          ∫ q in r..t, g q * ‖timeTranslate s u q - v q‖ ^ 2) :
    ComparisonData (timeTranslate s u) v (u s) T g Good

declarations.name: QFA.Assembly.TailComparison.restricted_restart_class_eq_singleton
declarations.signature:
theorem restricted_restart_class_eq_singleton
    {Admissible : V → Set (ℝ → V)} {u v : ℝ → V} {s δ : ℝ}
    (hsδ : s < δ)
    (hsource : ComparableOnNonnegative (timeTranslate s u) v (u s))
    (hreference : timeTranslate (δ - s) v ∈ Admissible (u δ))
    (hcomparisons : ∀ w ∈ Admissible (u δ),
      ComparableOnNonnegative w (timeTranslate (δ - s) v) (u δ)) :
    (fun w : ℝ → V => fun t : {t : ℝ // 0 ≤ t} => w t.1) '' Admissible (u δ) =
      {fun t : {t : ℝ // 0 ≤ t} => timeTranslate δ u t.1}

declarations.name: QFA.Assembly.Chain.exists_selected_reference_and_tail_singleton
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_selected_reference_and_tail_singleton
    {ν δ : ℝ} {a : RealSpatialL2}
    {u : Trajectory} {G : GradientTrajectory} {Good : ℝ → Prop}
    {Admissible : RealSpatialL2 → Set Trajectory}
    {Reference : RealSpatialL2 → Trajectory → Prop}
    (hProfile : EnergyProfile ν a u G) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hcut : ‖a‖ ^ 4 / (16 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < δ)
    (hweak : ∀ b : RealSpatialL2,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) b) (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hgood : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ),
      Good s ∧ EnergyStart ν u G s)
    (hRestart : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → Good s → EnergyStart ν u G s →
      timeTranslate s u ∈ Admissible (u s))
    (hReference : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → Good s →
      velocityEnergy (u s) * gradientEnergy (G s) < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4 →
      EnergyStart ν u G s → RestartData ν u G s →
        ∃ v : Trajectory, Reference (u s) v)
    (hPorts : ReferencePorts Admissible Reference) :
    SelectedTail ν δ Admissible Reference u G Good

declarations.name: QFA.Assembly.Chain.quantified_tail_assembly
declarations.signature:
theorem quantified_tail_assembly
    {ν : ℝ} {Domain : Set RealSpatialL2}
    {Admissible : RealSpatialL2 → Set Trajectory}
    {Reference : RealSpatialL2 → Trajectory → Prop}
    {Good : Trajectory → GradientTrajectory → ℝ → Prop}
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hClass : ClassRealization ν Domain Admissible Good)
    (hReference : SubcriticalReferenceConstruction ν Domain Admissible Reference Good)
    (hPorts : ReferencePorts Admissible Reference) :
    ∀ a ∈ Domain,
      (Admissible a).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Admissible a,
        u 0 = a ∧ Tendsto u (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a) ∧
        ∀ δ : ℝ, ‖a‖ ^ 4 / (16 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < δ →
          ∃ G : GradientTrajectory,
            EnergyProfile ν a u G ∧
              SelectedTail ν δ Admissible Reference u G (Good u G)

theorem quantified_tail_assembly_of_analytic_inputs
    {ν : ℝ} {Domain : Set RealSpatialL2}
    {Admissible : RealSpatialL2 → Set Trajectory}
    {Reference : RealSpatialL2 → Trajectory → Prop}
    {Good : Trajectory → GradientTrajectory → ℝ → Prop}
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hClass : Chain.ClassRealization ν Domain Admissible Good)
    (hPorts : Chain.ReferencePorts Admissible Reference)
    (hExtension : CompactToSchwartzEndpoint)
    (hSpectral : WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    (hReferenceBackend :
      ReferenceConstructionFromAbsorption ν Domain Admissible Reference Good) :
    ∀ a ∈ Domain,
      (Admissible a).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Admissible a,
        u 0 = a ∧ Tendsto u (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a) ∧
        ∀ δ : ℝ, ‖a‖ ^ 4 / (16 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < δ →
          ∃ G : GradientTrajectory,
            EnergyProfile ν a u G ∧
              Chain.SelectedTail ν δ Admissible Reference u G (Good u G)
